answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 756 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the trellis. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the sonnet queue while genuine members promoted earlier still earns. The knoll index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Slashing removes 73 percent at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
